meta.title: SparkChat | End-to-end encrypted messages and calls
meta.description: Chat and call with end-to-end encryption. Send photos, voice messages and GIFs, react with emoji, share your screen and talk to the SparkAI assistant, right in your browser.

hero.title: Messages and calls protected end to end
hero.lead: Send photos, voice messages and GIFs, react with emoji, video call and share your screen to watch a movie together. All encrypted in your browser, with {{colors}} colors to make the chat yours.
hero.note: Free, right in your browser or installed as an app.

features.title: Everything a good conversation needs
features.lead: From a quick note to a video call, without giving up privacy.

reactions.title: Reactions and emoji
reactions.text: Hold a message to react with a quick shortcut or any emoji from the full picker.

gifs.title: GIF gallery
gifs.text: Search and send GIFs without leaving the chat. They travel encrypted, just like any photo.

translation.title: On-device translation
translation.text: Messages in English or Portuguese get a Translate link. The text never goes to an outside service.

groups.title: Groups with invite links
groups.text: Create the group, send the link, done. The member list is signed and checked by everyone.

install.title: Install it as an app
install.text: Open it from your home screen and get calls and messages even when the app is closed. You can hide the text in alerts too.

photos.title: Profile photo
photos.text: Crop your photo or keep one of the avatars. Your photo is encrypted too.

calls.title: Call, share your screen and watch together
calls.lead: Free, encrypted voice and video calls between two people. Before connecting, the devices check each other’s keys.

voice.title: Voice call
voice.text: AI noise reduction on your device, echo cancellation and volume you can tune on each side.

video.title: Video call
video.text: Turn your camera on whenever you like and switch camera, microphone or speaker without hanging up.

share.title: Share your screen and watch together
share.text: Show a tab, a window or your whole screen. In movie mode, video stays smooth, up to 4K with stereo sound, and the show quiets down on its own when someone talks.

transfer.title: Switch devices mid-call
transfer.text: Started on your computer and need to head out? Tap Switch to this device on your phone and the call carries on where it left off.

facts.ring: Your phone rings even with the app closed

studio.title: Pick your chat colors
studio.lead: 3 modes and {{colors}} colors, with contrast tuned for every combination. Try it here: the whole page changes with it.
studio.seeAll: Sign in to see them all

security.title: Privacy that doesn't rely on trust
security.lead: Encryption happens in your browser. Not even SparkChat's server can read conversations between people, see the photos or listen to the calls.

keys.title: Your keys are born on your device
keys.text: When you create your account, the browser generates your key pair. The private key only leaves it protected by your password.

encrypt.title: Every message is encrypted before it leaves
encrypt.text: Text, photos, voice messages, GIFs, reactions and even group names travel scrambled, from your browser to their destination.

relay.title: The server only delivers
relay.text: It stores and forwards the encrypted content without being able to read what was written.

read.title: Only people in the conversation can read it
read.text: The message only becomes readable again on the devices of those in the conversation.

security.coveredText: Everything you send is scrambled on your device before it leaves, and only becomes readable again on the devices of the people in the conversation.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: What usually comes up before the first message.

free.question: Is SparkChat free?
free.answer: Yes, all of it: messages, voice and video calls, screen sharing and groups. To sign up you just pick an avatar, a username and a password, no card and no trial period.

privacy.question: Can SparkChat read my messages?
privacy.answer: No. Everything is encrypted in your browser with keys only the people in the conversation have: text, photos, voice messages, GIFs, reactions, group names and voice and video calls too. The server only stores and delivers scrambled content and can't open any of it. The one exception is your chat with the SparkAI assistant, which has to read what you write to answer.

watch.question: Can we watch a movie together?
watch.answer: Yes. During the call, tap Share screen and pick the video tab with the share audio option checked. In the Broadcast tab of the settings, turn on movie mode for smoother video and stereo sound, and choose how much the show quiets down when someone talks.

devices.question: Can I use it on my phone and computer at the same time?
devices.answer: Yes. Conversations, themes and even messages you deleted just for yourself stay in sync across devices. To sign in on a new device without losing your encrypted history, use the recovery file you get when you create your account. Keep it safe: without it and your password, there's no way to recover your messages.

install.question: Can I install it and get notifications?
install.answer: Yes. Tap Get the app to install SparkChat on your computer or phone: it opens in its own window and alerts you about calls and messages even when closed. The alert arrives empty and your own device shows the preview, and you can hide message text. On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work with SparkChat added to the Home Screen.

groups.question: How do groups work?
groups.answer: Give the group a name and a photo and share the invite link with anyone you like. Admins remove members and reset the link, and the member list is signed: if someone tries to slip in unnoticed, the other members' devices catch it.
